description: Native reference application, October 3, 2026. A separately authored four-slide deck exercises double/single page curls with both X inversion values. The native reference application opens it without repair, shows the page-curl transition selected, and displays 2.85-second duration, click advance disabled and 8.70-second automatic advance on the first control. After native save, independent raw XML extraction verifies all four controls retain their preset, X inversion, duration, speed and advance properties. This validates XML interoperability; native curl playback in the application remains pending.
